## Checklist

- [ ] The PR is focused and its title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, etc.).
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior or the reason for omitting tests is documented.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when commands, configuration, or supported behavior changed.
- [ ] No secrets, private prompts, or sensitive paths are included.
